question_text: How many distinct object_id values were tracked at Gate_MainEntrance across all entry/exit events on 2025-12-08 (UTC)?
answer_text: There were 2,951 distinct object_id values tracked at Gate_MainEntrance across all entry/exit events on 2025-12-08 (UTC).

citations.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT object_id) AS distinct_object_ids
FROM events
WHERE camera_location LIKE '%MainEntrance%'
  AND timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' 
  AND timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  AND event_type IN ('person_entry', 'person_exit', 'car_entry', 'car_exit')
